kernel.governing_law: What was intimate and sufficient — adornment, warmth, love — is narrated from a distance that has already lost it; the speaker possesses only the retrospective frame, never the thing itself.
kernel.mutated_relation: The lost thing possesses the speaker — the ornament binds her, the stillness inhabits her, the small awkward beloved is the one who held the shape of her; distance collapses into the discovered fact that the object was always the origin.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
*Sappho 98a*

When I am old,
my daughter asks,
I cannot unclasp grey wrists
from a stain that won't lift,

or knotted dry thread
through a nerve of winter white,
and that was a difficult possession.

Then I was worn by quiet certainties
grown in the body.

*Sappho 42*

when a slow heat
    rises from the marrow, pulse
crowds,
    then roaring

*Sappho 49*

just now you held me, Atthis,
when you were a vast hand,
and I was so
open and
claimed.

independent.recovered_law: In Text A, the speaker looks backward from the present to a past of youth, simplicity, and lightness (mother recalls girlhood, cold brings stillness, 'long ago I loved you when you were tiny'). In Text B, every temporal and relational direction is reversed: the old speaker faces forward or inward, the child becomes the questioner, cold becomes heat, stillness becomes roaring, the active lover becomes the passive one held/claimed, and simplicity becomes difficult possession.
independent.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a broad reversal of relational direction (active→passive, possessor→possessed), which partially overlaps the declared change that the object/thing now possesses/binds/inhabits the speaker. However, the recovered claim is much broader — covering temporal reversal, sensory inversions, and multiple structural flips — making it an adjacent but not identical characterization of the mutation.
independent.terminal_note: The final fragment (Sappho 49) fully maintains the reversed agency and directionality: the speaker is now the object acted upon rather than the agent, consistent with the inversion throughout Text B.
